resources.string:
You are now on %1$s. Settings and data left over from older versions may not be compatible with this version and can cause unexpected bugs that do not occur in normal use. Clearing the app data for a clean install is recommended.

App data is cleared on the system App info › Storage page. To reset only the settings, use Settings › Maintenance › Restore default configuration (songs, playlists and listening history are kept).

When reporting a problem, please make sure it happens on a clean install of the latest version with data cleared, not on an over-install of an older version without clearing data.
Open Storage and choose Clear data
